basics.name: Kathleen West
basics.label: PhD Student
basics.summary: Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science at the University of Glasgow. Research focused on the carbon-aware execution of scientific workflows on heterogeneous clusters. Interested in future opportunities as a postdoctoral researcher or research scientist positions.

work.name: University of Glasgow
work.summary: Contributed to EPSRC-funded project `Casper: Carbon-Aware Scalable Processing in Elastic Clusters', working with Dr Lauritz Thamsen and the project's academic partner. Worked within a team to develop new carbon-aware or low-carbon computing methods.

work.name: Barclays UK
work.summary: Worked as a member of the Data Processing and Orchestration team, operating in an agile manner. Developed and maintained 40+ components written in Java using the Spring Framework and Apache Camel to facilitate integration. Developed functionality written in Python to be deployed on AWS infrastructure.

volunteer.summary: Coordinated committee team supporting club with 300+ members, arrangement of events, supported student wellbeing.
